text:
sophia: heads up — big tail latency & increased 5xx starting ~16:24 UTC. graphs show request queueing on gen endpoints in eu-west1. looks correlated with spot GPU evictions in the mixed-capacity pool. anyone on call?

infra-bot: ALERT: high_eviction_rate detected in eu-west1-spot-pool (12 evictions / 5m). Affected ASG: rw-infer-mixed-eu-west1. Metrics: p99 latency up 3x, 502s increasing. https://grafana/reports/evictions-eu-west1

raj: on it. first mitigation: drain remaining spot nodes and failover traffic to dedicated. can we scale dedicated by +25% asap and toggle routing to prefer reserved?

eva: starting scale now — issuing api call to infra autoscaler.

eva: command run: 
```bash
infractl scale --pool dedicated-eu-west1 --delta +25% --reason "spot evictions fallback"
```

kai: fyi the mixed pool has a 30% spot ratio; we lost ~40% of active spot GPUs (12/30). root cause looks like provider maintenance combined with a short-lived price spike.

taylor: noticed connection resets causing the batching proxy to backoff; long-lived sockets dropped -> queueing for new model sessions. recommend reducing batch window to 50ms temporarily.

raj: agree. eva — can you drop batch window on gen-route eu-west1 to v2 (50ms) and redeploy config?

eva: applying config patch now: 
```yaml
routes:
  gen-eu-west1:
    batch_window_ms: 50
```

infra-bot: Action log: autoscaler scale +25% succeeded (5 new dedicated replicas). routing policy updated: prefer_dedicated=true for eu-west1.

oncall-amber: re-routing in place, starting warmup of dedicated instances. watching queues.

sophia: quick note — users report degraded latency on some tenants but overall traffic still served. thanks for the fast moves.

kai: suggestion for medium term: enable graceful eviction handler in the spot nodes to flush KV caches and signal the scheduler earlier (gives ~10s for in-flight to finish). also increase reserved headroom target to 20%.

taylor: current p99 dropping back toward normal after scaling + batch change. p50 fine. 502 rate down to near baseline.

eva: rolling drain completed for remaining spot nodes. no more evictions in last 3m in eu-west1.

infra-bot: RESOLVED ALERT: high_eviction_rate cleared. incident window ~18m.

raj: postmortem actions: 1) add eviction-rate alert threshold (5/min) with auto-fallback to dedicated; 2) PR to autoscaler to keep 20% reserved headroom on mixed pools; 3) enable graceful-eviction-handler as opt-in for spot images; 4) update runbook with batch-window fallback. assigning owners.

taylor: I'll add the alert and update runbook.

raj: I'll open the autoscaler PR and schedule a short post-incident review tomorrow.

sophia: thanks everyone. follow-up meeting: tomorrow 09:30 UTC to finalize strategy across regions.

oncall-amber: marking oncall handoff notes. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
